item.subject: science
item.stem: Which event names a force as a push or pull between two objects?

options.A: Vikram kicks a football — a push between his foot and the ball
options.B: A ball sits still on grass — the ball applies a force to itself
options.C: Noor pulls a wagon — the pull acts only on the wagon
options.D: A leaf falls — no objects are interacting

rows: a push between his foot and the ball
A ball sits still on grass
the ball applies a force to itself
the pull acts only on the wagon

learn_by_solve.solve: Can the learner use indicator observations to decide whether a tested substance is acidic, basic, or neutral?

followup.stem: Assign oxidation numbers first. The species is [[1]] if OS increases, [[2]] if OS decreases, or [[3]] if OS stays the same.
followup.why: Acids turn blue litmus red, bases turn red litmus blue, and indicators or olfactory indicators signal acidic or basic media by observable colour or odour changes. This is the hinge move, not a reprint of the clicked option.
